method: Crop the main ¾ figure panel region.
Flatten the sheet's own alpha (if any) over the panel colour measured as the median of the crop's 3 px border ring [251, 247, 234].

Key the panel background with app-momee's keyImage algorithm (border flood fill at tolerance 12, speck removal, 2 px edge band unmixed per pixel against the best 7×7 figure colour, unexplained pixels kept opaque).
Clear owner-reviewable enclosed background gaps from explicit seeds listed in candidates/m1.0j-construction/boy.params.json (pocketNotes).
Separate the baked ground shadow: flood only from the outer background into near-neutral warm darkening of the panel colour in the bottom 12% band; move it to its own layer.
Never alter opaque figure pixels (verified: 0 of 73811 changed).
Native canvas = whole-pixel translation onto a padded canvas with the feet anchor centred (no resampling).
Tiers = one uniform premultiplied area-average downscale onto the M1.0i canvases/anchors (Boy 160×224 / 320×448 at (80,216)/(160,432); Mom 200×312 at (100,304)). Never enlarged.
